Bring Azure Kubernetes Service to Your Own Hardware (AKS on Ubuntu)
posts.description: Running Kubernetes on-premises no longer requires building custom cluster infrastructure from scratch. With Azure Arc and the hybrid capabilities of Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), you can deploy and manage fully managed Kubernetes clusters directly on your own bare-metal Ubuntu hardware.
